loss: Raw-output MAE; equal observed leads, then anchors, then CVEs
selection: Strict minimum clipped validation Day-30 to Day-60 MAE; earliest tie
correction: Training-only weighted median residual per lead; weights from the full lead/anchor/CVE loss, conditioned on that lead; missing lead uses zero
interpretation: Forecast stored future EPSS scores, not exploitation; date-level availability only; previously exposed test is not a new independent holdout
